170.DSCR:
A young man working in space development. 24 years old.
He majored in aerospace engineering as a student, and was $$刹那$$'s next-door neighbor at their apartment while $$刹那$$ was undercover.
His parents had already passed away. His older sister was also killed after becoming involved with the Gundams, leaving him with no family left, and his girlfriend $$ルイス$$ left him after she too was caught up in a $$ガンダム$$ attack.
Even so, he took the job in space development he had dreamed of, but was suspected of being a $$カタロン$$ operative and detained. $$刹那$$ and the others rescued him there, and he began acting alongside them.
At first he harbored resentment toward $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, the organization that had cost him his family and $$ルイス$$, but on learning that $$ルイス$$ was among the $$アロウズ$$ pilots, he resolved to stand on the battlefield in order to win her back.
His feelings against fighting never changed, but he came to believe that he should 'still do what he can do now,' and boarded the $$オーライザー$$. He fought in his own way while supporting $$刹那$$.
In the final battle, the $$トランザムバースト$$ triggered by the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ let him share consciousness with $$ルイス$$. After a desperate appeal, he succeeded in bringing her back.
He has since left $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, and now works in the space elevator industry while caring for $$ルイス$$, who still suffers aftereffects.

171.DSCR:
A former $$アロウズ$$ pilot. 24 years old.
She once lived in a world untouched by conflict, an exchange student from Spain living in Japan, and she and $$沙慈$$ made a well-matched couple.
But when $$ネーナ$$'s whim cost her her parents, many relatives, and her own left hand, she broke with $$沙慈$$ and chose the path of revenge against the Gundams.
Born into a wealthy family, she funded $$アロウズ$$ with the large inheritance she received. Though her rank was only warrant officer, she enjoyed generous treatment from the higher-ups in various ways, from having her opinions heard to being issued new-model machines.
Her experience as a soldier was shallow and her lack of skill undeniable, and she suffered from cellular damage caused by past exposure to GN particles from a quasi-solar furnace, requiring her to take sedatives. Despite these problems, she threw herself into battle carrying her hatred of the Gundams.
$$リボンズ$$ took advantage of this, using her as a test subject to awaken artificial $$イノベイター$$s by continually administering her nanomachines in the form of a sedative. As a result, her body came to require regular sedative doses.
When she confronted $$沙慈$$ in person during the final battle, hatred and rage drove her into a deranged state, but the Trans-Am Burst let her and $$沙慈$$ understand each other, and she regained her sanity. The cellular damage that had been eating away at her body was also removed by the power of GN particles.
However, she has yet to overcome the aftereffects of the nanomachines $$リボンズ$$ administered to her and the PTSD from the war. Even two years after the war's end, she remains hospitalized, cared for by $$沙慈$$.

172.DSCR:
First princess of the $$アザディスタン王国$$. 31 years old.
She was raised as an ordinary citizen, but was placed at the head of the restored monarchy in order to rebuild her country's economy after its oil resources ran dry.
As a national leader, her will to reform her troubled country is strong, but her lack of experience as a leader made her a target of criticism from reformists and hatred from conservatives alike.
She met $$刹那$$ after being caught up in the fighting, and though both of them wished for peace, differences in how they chose to live kept pulling them apart.
Her association with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ led to her being suspected and detained for a time, but she was rescued by $$刹那$$ and the others, together with $$アレルヤ$$.
However, her homeland was devastated by $$サーシェス$$ and placed under Federation control, and from then on she acted together with $$カタロン$$.
As the fighting spread, she searched for a path other than fighting, and wrote a song with a group of children to bring her wish for peace to the world. The song spread across the globe and became a driving force for peace.
After the war she returned as princess of a rebuilt $$アザディスタン$$, and now works to reverse the policies the Earth Federation government pursued during the war.

178.DSCR:
One of the $$ガンダム$$ Meisters belonging to $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
He pilots the $$ガンダムデュナメス$$. 24 years old.
His being the oldest and his caring nature worked against him, and he ended up serving as the coordinator of the $$ガンダム$$ Meisters, such as $$刹那$$, who lacked cooperativeness. Even $$ハロ$$ pointed out that he had drawn the short straw in this.
He had lost his parents and younger sister to an indiscriminate suicide bombing in the past, and hated terrorists.
When, by a certain chance, he learned that $$刹那$$ had been involved with the organization that carried out that terrorist attack, he showed his anger openly. But on learning of $$刹那$$'s resolve, he came to recognize that $$アリー・アル・サーシェス$$, who had led the organization, was the very enemy to be struck down.
During the assault by the $$国連$$ forces, he shielded $$ティエリア$$ and was injured in his dominant eye. Dr. $$モレノ$$, the attending physician of the $$プトレマイオス$$, diagnosed him as needing absolute rest for two weeks, but he refused treatment out of concern for the loss of combat strength.
$$ティエリア$$ locked his room so as not to let him overexert himself, but he broke out and sortied anyway. While charging in with the $$ＧＮアーマー$$ to strike the enemy mothership, he came face to face with his old nemesis $$サーシェス$$. After a fierce battle he defeated $$サーシェス$$, but he himself also perished in the explosion.
The way he lived influenced the members of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ in many ways.

179.DSCR:
Helmsman of the $$プトレマイオス$$. 21 years old.
Usually cheerful and humble, a handsome-but-comical type who tends to be seen as a lightweight. But his skill at the helm was first-rate, and he handled the $$プトレマイオス$$ masterfully.
He showed his fondness for $$クリス$$ and treated her kindly, but she was not interested and brushed him off lightly.
Later, in a conversation with the crew of the $$トレミー$$, he revealed that he had lost his parents, who had been space elevator engineers, in the $$太陽光発電紛争$$ of the past.
During the fighting against the $$国連$$ forces, his feelings finally reached $$クリス$$, but he vanished together with her in the flames of the $$プトレマイオス$$ explosion.

180.DSCR:
Tactical operator of the $$プトレマイオス$$. 22 years old.
Strong with computers, she has advanced programming skills and hacking ability. She joined $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ not so much out of agreement with its guiding principles as because it was a place where she could put her own skills to use.
She had a bright, lively personality, but lacking resolve for combat, she also showed a mentally fragile side, panicking when driven into a corner.
She is quite particular about looks, and flatly dismissed $$リヒティ$$, who made advances on her, as 'not my type.'
She has a mother who raised her in a colony, but she herself has said that their relationship is not very good.
During the fighting against the allied forces of the three great powers, she accepted $$リヒティ$$'s feelings, but vanished together with him in the flames of the $$プトレマイオス$$ explosion.

181.DSCR:
The pilot of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$. 16 years old.
He grew up without knowing his father's face, but after his mother's death, his estranged father arranged for him to attend the $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス工業専門学校$$ on the space colony $$インダストリアル７$$.
When he saved $$オードリー$$ after she fell from the colony sky, he was drawn into the conflict over '$$ラプラスの箱$$.' During the fighting on $$インダストリアル７$$, he boarded the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, entrusted to him by his father $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, and from then on found himself, as if guided, fighting his way across the world.
Because he is a civilian, he is not bound by any faction's ideology, and he alone in the midst of the war has the strength to voice a purely human opinion, along with a gentleness that makes him care for others.
That purity showed even after $$オードリー$$ turned out to be $$ミネバ$$ Zabi, in that he kept calling her $$オードリー$$, and it became part of the charm that drew in the people around him, such as $$オードリー$$, $$マリーダ$$, $$ギルボア$$, and $$ダグザ$$.
Because he could withstand the strain of Destroy Mode, a burden ordinary people should not be able to bear, and because he had received special training as a child, he was suspected for a time of being an Enhanced Human, but no trace of drug administration was found, so the suspicion was dropped.
Though he was just a civilian, he grew through the bonds he formed with many people during the journey over the Box.
In the midst of the fighting, he became self-destructive for a time after shooting down $$ギルボア$$, who had looked after him, but he recovered through talking with $$ジンネマン$$. After witnessing the vengeful grudge of $$ジオン$$ returned at $$トリントン基地$$, he resolved to stand against unreasoning cruelty, whether from the Federation or $$ジオン$$.

182.DSCR:
A young pilot with $$ロンド・ベル$$. Rank of ensign. 23 years old.
The eldest son of the $$マーセナス家$$, a family of politicians, he joined the military to escape the constraints of his family.
He wants to make his own way regardless of his family name, but is secretly weary of the family's influence, which follows him no matter what he does.
He is more interested in fighter planes than mobile suits, and always carries a pendant containing a small biplane model as a good-luck charm.
He initially piloted a $$リゼル$$, but switched to a $$デルタプラス$$ after the battle with the $$シナンジュ$$.
A good-natured young man, he is drawn to $$オードリー$$.
After learning her true identity, he was drawn even more to her nobility, and used the family influence he had once despised to grant her wish, descending to Earth together with her in the $$デルタプラス$$.
But on Earth, his father $$ローナン$$ told him of the connection between the Box and the $$マーセナス家$$, and he fell into despair over his own bloodline. He sought salvation from $$ミネバ$$, but this only ended up disappointing her.
Afterward, at $$ローナン$$'s wishes, he was dispatched to the $$ラー・カイラム$$.

Please decide the ship's English once.
pilot 174 DSC2: 大統領特使 rendered 'a special envoy of the $$大統領$$' using the proposed token for pilot 175 (English 'President').

pilot 175: the Jigoku English used 'He' for the President. The Japanese has no pronoun and the glossary has no gender for 大統領, so I used 'The $$大統領$$' instead (deviating from Jigoku) in DSCR and DSC2. The Jigoku sentence about joining nations was also changed to match the new Tengoku wording (それまでは参加を拒否していた国 = nations that had refused to participate until then).

pilot 176 (Descartes): no pronouns in the Japanese and the gender is not given anywhere, so the name is repeated ('$$デカルト$$ ...'). 純粋種 = 'pure strain'; 火星付近 = 'near Mars'; 大尉 = captain. Same approach for 191 (Nigel), 212 (Darryl), 213 (Watts) where the Japanese has no pronoun: I wrote without he/his (191 DSCR: 'Backed by confidence in a high level of skill, $$ナイジェル$$ says what needs to be said...'; 212: 'Distinguished by a Latin look...'; 213: 'Blunt and unpretentious...').

Gender kept from Jigoku for known characters where the Japanese has no pronoun: Hasan (190), Alec (199), Gael (209), Frontal (181/192), Klaus (174), Billy (168), Lockon/Neil (178, male; sole sentence with 'he' not in Japanese) and Lichty (179). If any of these should be gender-neutral, they need re-checking; the Jigoku English shipped 'he' for Hasan, Alec, Gael, Klaus and Billy.

pilot 177: アーミア・リー - I found no wiki source; 'Amia Lee' is from memory of the movie credits (could be 'Amea' or 'Ami' in some sources). 女子高生 = 'high school girl' (she is female per the entry). 半身が金属結晶化 = 'half of her body turned to metal crystal'.

pilot 178 (Lockon): the DSCR is Neil Dylandy, not Lyle; Jigoku entry 102 was about Lyle, so nothing from it was reused. 妹 = 'younger sister' (Jigoku wrote 'sister'), 利き目 = 'dominant eye', 敵母艦 = 'enemy mothership'. The token used for the GN Arms/Dynames is new ($$ガンダムデュナメス$$, $$ＧＮアーマー$$). 因縁の = 'old nemesis' is my rendering.

pilot 179/180: トレミー (the crew nickname for the Ptolemaios) has no source; I proposed 'Ptolemy' for the token ($$トレミー$$); alternatives are 'Tolemy' or 'Trémy'. 二枚目半 rendered 'handsome-but-comical type'. 180 says the fight was against 三大国家の連合軍 ('the allied forces of the three great powers') while 179 (same event) says 国連軍 ('$$ＵＮ$$ forces'); I kept each as written. 戦況オペレーター = 'tactical operator'. 面食い = 'quite particular about looks'.

pilot 181-183, 194, 207: ユニコーン (bare) is a new token ($$ユニコーン$$, English 'Unicorn'), following Jigoku's 'the Unicorn'. The Jigoku wording 'unreasoning cruelty' for 理不尽な行い and 'came to understand him' for 心を通わせる were kept unchanged in 181 and 196 although the Japanese is closer to 'unreasonable acts' and 'connected with him'.

pilot 181 DSC2: 宇宙の刻の果て = 'the end of the universe's time' (used again in 192); 受け止める for the colony laser is 'stopped' everywhere (181, 182, 208, 210, 207). Sentence 181: 'the journey over the Box' kept from Jigoku (bare 箱, not tokenized).
pilot 182 / 183 have identical Japanese (same source hashes) and identical English.
pilot 184: kept Jigoku 'the battle to retake $$パラオ$$' for パラオ攻略戦 (攻略 is more like 'capture/assault'); also kept in 186. Jigoku 'he steels his resolve' for 覚悟を決めて.

pilot 191-193: 大尉 = 'captain' (as Jigoku for Angelo), 中尉 = 'lieutenant' (212, 213, 194). 支援用量産機 = 'mass-produced support unit'. In 193 DSC2 the Japanese has a stray '、。' after ローゼン・ズールを与えられるが; I read it as a typo and translated 'but while fighting the Unicorn ...'. 亡骸 = 'body'.
pilot 192: Jigoku's "'Char's Successor'" for 「シャアの再来」 is kept (再来 is closer to 'return'/'reincarnation'). 噛ませ犬 kept as Jigoku's 'sacrificial pawn'.

pilot 194/195: プル・トゥエルブ (with a middle dot, in 194 DSC2) is a different spelling from the glossary's プルトゥエルブ, so it is its own token with the same English (Ple Twelve). プル (the Ple series / Ple clones) is a new token, 'Ple' as in Jigoku. Official English is often 'Puru Twelve'/'Pull Twelve'; I kept Jigoku's 'Ple'.
pilot 196: Jigoku wrote the Garencieres was 'heavily damaged' for 中破 (moderately/medium damaged); I changed it to 'moderately damaged' since the Japanese is not 大破. All other Jigoku sentences kept.
pilot 197/199 possessive: 'the $$袖付き$$' $$ガランシェール$$ unit' - token English 'Sleeves' with a plural-style possessive apostrophe outside the token, as Jigoku wrote 'the Sleeves''.

pilot 207: Jigoku wrote 'the Ecoes' (typo); the token エコーズ has English 'Echoes' (as in Jigoku's 'Echoes 920' in 187). 209 'first head' (初代当主) and 211 'Patriarch' (宗主) are my choices: 宗主 is not 当主 (used for Cardeas as 'head').

pilot 209 DSC2: シルヴァ・バレト rendered 'Silver Bullet' (I believe the official English is 'Silver Bullet Suppressor' for the full name, but the Japanese here is only シルヴァ・バレト); no source in the akurasu files.
pilot 211: 氷室 = 'ice chamber' (cold-storage room where Syam Vist lies); 前時代 = 'the era before the Universal Century'. Neither has a source.

pilot 212: the spelling 'Darryl McGuinness' vs 'Daryl' is unverified. 'Nigel Garrett' is from the akurasu Z3.2 pilot database; the other Tri-Star names are from memory of Gundam Unicorn's official English.
pilot 168 DSC2 vs 169 DSC2: アタックを仕掛けていた is 'pursuing him aggressively' in 168 and 'making bold advances on him' in 169 (same meaning; worded differently only to avoid repeating a name/pronoun).
GENDER/PRONOUN for Chris (180), Lichty (179): the Japanese has 彼女 for Chris and the entry is a known character; used she/he accordingly.
